As-is state · captured live 2026-07-20

Vantage — every screen, as built

A screen-by-screen snapshot of the application as it runs today, with what each screen does and where its data comes from — the baseline for grading against industry standards. All captures are the real app against live data (light theme, 1600px viewport).

Architecture & cross-cutting facts

Stack: React SPA (hash routes, esbuild bundle, Looley design system, served by nginx :8642) · FastAPI backend (:8641, SQLite store) · MCP server (:8640) · Mira LLM service (:8080, SSE streaming; supervisor routes prompts to specialist analysts).

Data: 7 linked brokerage accounts (Robinhood ×2, Fidelity ×3, Zerodha, Schwab) synced read-only via broker MCP; market data via yfinance; intraday cron refreshes bars + account history during RTH. Dual-currency (USD/INR) throughout.

Safety doctrine: read-only by design (ADR-010) — Vantage never places live orders or moves funds. The one execution carve-out is Alpaca PAPER for strategy validation, and autonomous/live execution sits behind four hard gates (ADR-015: kill switch + two env flags + per-strategy caps), all currently un-armed.

AI posture: deterministic numbers are computed in code and handed to the LLM to narrate — the model cites, it doesn't recompute. Every AI surface is labeled “educational only — not financial advice,” and a persistent banner says the same app-wide. A per-symbol Notebook rail (right side of every screen) answers ad-hoc questions grounded in the engine.

01

Portfolio

#/portfolio

Cross-account roll-up analysis — the top-level 'what do I own' view.

  • Account chips with per-account value across 7 linked brokerages (Robinhood ×2, Fidelity ×3, Zerodha, Schwab); dual-currency display (USD / INR) for the cross-border book.
  • Analysis cards: Diversification (HHI concentration score + sector weight bars + concentrated-names callout), Winners & losers (by gain %), Risk (annualized vol, Sortino, max drawdown, Sharpe), Income (projected annual dividends per holding), Rebalance (drift vs a target model with suggested $ adds/trims), Portfolio character (weighted beta, blended P/E, beta coverage).
  • 'Analyze my portfolio' runs Mira portfolio actions — AI reads the portfolio and recommends actions, framed as decision-support, not orders.
  • Visible gaps in this snapshot: 41.9% of sector weight is 'Unknown' (unclassified holdings — mostly Indian tickers) and Charles Schwab has no imported holdings (excluded, with an inline banner).
02

Dashboard

#/dashboard

The morning brief — market, portfolio, and AI-advisor read on one page, marked to last close.

  • Market today: the four index tiles with change and a one-line direction read; data source + timestamp shown.
  • Mira advisor read: grounded observations from advisory queries (wash-sale status, tax-loss-harvest candidates, allocation) with an explicit confidence label and a standing disclaimer that these are observations, never trade instructions.
  • Portfolio today: total value (dual currency), day P/L, unrealized P/L, harvestable losses with estimated tax benefit.
  • Allocation-by-asset-class bar vs target (70/10/15/5) with per-class drift chips; per-account tiles with last-sync age; Actions list of recommendations (e.g. CLOSE & BOOK LOSS with dollar reasoning) below.
03

Positions

#/holdings

Every holding across all accounts, grouped by symbol — the working position list.

  • 56 tickers, 9 flagged actionable; filter tabs (All / Has equity / Has options / Losers), a recommendation filter, sort, and symbol search.
  • Columns: value, day change, unrealized P/L, portfolio weight, and a recommendation chip per row (MONITOR, CLOSE & BOOK LOSS with the bookable $, HOLD & SELL CALL with strike + estimated credit).
  • Structural badges: 'Concentrated' warnings, option-position counts (1 OPT / 2 OPT), and sleeves (CRYPTO valued via the broker portfolio). Rows expand to the underlying lots.
  • Mixed-currency book rendered natively (₹ and $ rows side by side).
04

Tax Center

#/tax

Realized gains plus a tax-loss-harvesting engine across all linked accounts.

  • Realized gains YTD: short-term vs long-term split with lot counts and estimated tax owed at configured rates (24% ST / 15% LT).
  • Honesty banner: $107k of sells have no imported buy history — cost basis unknown, gain deliberately not computed (named tickers).
  • TLH engine: every lot marked to last close; wash-sale window checked across ALL linked accounts; per-lot status (Clear to harvest / N-A tax-advantaged) with an action sentence ('Sell, wait 31 days to rebuy — no like-exposure partner for single stock').
  • Threshold config ($200 or 3%) and an explicit 'decision-support only, no orders placed' framing.
05

Chart

#/ic/SPX

The instrument chart — TradingView Lightweight-Charts with the app's own 'Vantage DNA' analysis layers.

  • Timeframes 1m→1M, indicator toggles (MA20/50, VWAP, Volume, RSI), and drawing tools; symbol switcher opens any ticker.
  • DNA layer chips overlay the engine's derived structure: coach Levels, Order Blocks, FVG, Liquidity, prior-day H/L/C, GEX anchors, the investor's own Position (cost basis/plan), and the analyst Forecast path.
  • First-class '🔮 Forecast now' action: refreshes bars, streams a Mira forward forecast (current price → close), draws the numbered projected path + target/invalidation lines on the chart, and shows the reasoning in the right pane.
  • Replay mode steps through a past day's saved forecast sequence with per-call hit/miss grading drawn on the chart.
06

Today

#/today

The 0DTE trading cockpit — signals, open risk, the day's plan, and system health in one screen.

  • Signal bot cards: side + ticker, entry/stop/target (or open-ended), computed $ risk, and an Execute button (paper); waiting-state signals show their arm condition.
  • Positions-at-risk strip (flat here) keeps live exposure in front of the operator.
  • 'Why — today's read': the rewritten plain-English playbook with Pine / Reclaim Pine / Coach Pine exports for TradingView verification.
  • Strategy health panel answers 'is the strategy working' with recent WR, net P&L and count — including a red stop-and-revalidate warning when losing; machine health shows jobs OK/failed and last runtime.
07

Options

#/options

Live option strategies rolled up from raw broker legs into structures.

  • Tabs: Open (18) / History (200) / By ticker (16). Grouping is by strategy structure, not raw fills — singles, debit spreads, multi-leg complexes each labeled.
  • Columns: underlying, expiry with DTE, net cost, current mark, unrealized P/L (green/red).
  • Marks are live; shorts netted (net-of-shorts noted in the header).
  • Rows expand to legs; educational-only framing in the header.
08

Daily plan

#/playbook

The 0DTE SPX playbook — machine-computed levels narrated into a plain-English plan.

  • Per-symbol tabs (SPX/QQQ/IWM); header stat chips: spot, gamma flip, put wall, call wall; regime line (dealer gamma sign, VIX band).
  • Today's read: key levels (resistance/pivot/support with sources like call wall, max pain), if/then setups, what-to-watch — plus an honest caveat that the GEX read is computed from overnight OI and is blind to 0DTE positioning (context, not signal).
  • Market Context block: native breadth (% above 50-day), VIX term structure, sector rotation, and intermarket (DXY etc.) — the whole-market backdrop behind the bias.
  • Export to Pine / Recompute actions; structure + volume one-liners under the read.
09

Scanner

#/scanner

Backtest-validated ICT hourly setup scanner across the Nasdaq-100 + S&P top-100.

  • Coverage line (162/162 tickers, counts by tier, last run age) and a tier selector; A+ requires confluence AND a minimum FVG size (backtested grade), so the honest empty state says 'A+ is deliberately rare — a quiet scan is normal'.
  • Watch tickers: ad-hoc names always scanned.
  • History grid shows how aged setups played out — per ticker: tier + side, age, and outcome chip (✓ target / ✕ invalid / open). Stale setups are retired into history with a data-through stamp rather than lingering as current.
  • A+ setups auto-submit real multi-leg debit spreads to Alpaca PAPER (strategy-lifecycle carve-out); footer states the drop-to-lower-timeframe usage note.
10

Strategies

#/strategies

The strategy lifecycle — paper → gate → promote → autonomous, with hard safety gates.

  • Dry-run (safe) banner: autonomous is not armed; orders record what they would do but reach no broker. Gate status shown explicitly (VANTAGE_LIVE_OK ✕ · VANTAGE_AUTONOMOUS_OK ✕ · kill switch clear).
  • Per-strategy card: current stage (PAPER), symbols, paper win-rate vs the frozen backtest baseline, sample progress (24/20 trades), and gate verdict ('gate not met' — no frozen baseline available yet).
  • Promotion rule stated inline: promotable only when paper WR beats the frozen backtest baseline over the minimum sample.
  • Audit trail expander per strategy; Track record tab holds the equity curve + unified trade tables per book.
11

Trading Journal

#/journal

The trade journal — every day's decisions reconstructed from broker fills, graded against the day's plan.

  • Day strip with per-day P/L tint for the month; Days/Analysis tabs.
  • Deterministic stats strip per day: P&L, fills vs expiry split, W/L, win rate, profit factor, SPX settle, entered/exited-at-level discipline percentages.
  • Each row is a reconstructed decision (multi-leg grouping, scale ladders) pinned to the underlying's price at entry/exit and correlated to the day's forecast levels (level chips per row).
  • '🧬 Analyze today' runs an AI desk review per closed trade (skipping already-analyzed ones), then a book-level Day synthesis (direction / time-of-day / allocation patterns, swings separated from 0DTE intraday). The Analysis tab runs a windowed SWOT with rubric scores, a pattern census with citations, overall WR/PF, and compounds on the prior analysis.
12

Futures

#/futures

Imported futures round-trips with performance stats and rule recommendations derived from the trader's own numbers.

  • Headline tiles: expectancy per trade, reward:risk, win rate, profit factor, max drawdown — over 68 round-trips.
  • Honest partial-data banner: the CSV export is a window, not full history; computed P&L deliberately not reconciled to broker realized PnL, and the sample framed as partial.
  • Equity curve (cumulative P&L vs running peak).
  • Recommendations are quantified from the data: aim bigger winners (avg win vs loss cited), time-stop losers (median hold vs longest loser), daily stop after streaks, cut order-churn (47% cancels), and do-more/do-less hour-of-day edges with n and $.
13

Performance

#/trades

Trade analytics — the round-trip record filtered to statistically defensible edges.

  • Headline tiles: win rate, profit factor (flagged 'below breakeven' in red), average hold, average MFE capture, closed-trade count.
  • Edges & leaks: a condition is promoted only when its 90% credible interval clears the baseline win rate with enough trades ('Thursday · 75% · n=8 · edge'); everything thinner is held back.
  • All-conditions table: every entry condition with n, win rate, a drawn credible-interval bar vs baseline, and avg P/L; underpowered rows are muted and labeled 'n too small — don't read as signal'.
  • Educational-only framing; as-of date shown in the header.
Captured 2026-07-20 with Playwright at 1600×1000 CSS px against the running local stack; content reflects real account data and that day's market session. Known visible gaps are stated inline per screen (unclassified sectors, unimported Schwab holdings, partial futures history, dated performance as-of) — they are part of the as-is state. Screens not shown: Settings, account-manage modal, mobile layouts, and right-pane variants (Replay, Chat).
